father_mother_goes_out_mother_left_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, your Other Mother has popped out, has she? Well, she's always got a hundred little things to attend to. Don't mind me, kiddo. I'll be at the piano if you need anything.

father_mother_goes_out_mother_left_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, she's gone out for a while? Yes, she does that from time to time. I couldn't tell you exactly where she goes, though. She rather likes to keep certain things to herself.

father_mother_goes_out_when_return_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: When will she be back? Oh, goodness, I haven't the faintest idea! She tends to return whenever she's finished whatever it is she's doing. Best not to worry about it.

father_mother_goes_out_when_return_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, well, your Other Mother can be rather unpredictable about these things. Sometimes she's back before I've even finished a piece of music. Other times, I have time to play the whole thing twice!
